report:
Does TimescaleDB SMT handles DELETE?

Hello,
Debezium's TimescaleDB SMT documentation gives an example of a setup that handles INSERT and UPDATE operations... but not DELETE operations: https://debezium.io/documentation/reference/stable/transformations/timescaledb.html
```
CREATE PUBLICATION dbz_publication FOR ALL TABLES WITH (publish = 'insert, update')
```
However, we can perform DELETE operations on TimescaleDB hypertables (see https://docs.timescale.com/use-timescale/latest/write-data/delete/)
Does TimescaleDB SMT handle DELETE operations correctly? Or are there any limitations on this?
On a test connector (database "test"), with a TimescaleDB hypertable "conditions":
INSERTs and UPDATEs on table "conditions" are handled as expected (=> routed to mynamespace.test.conditions topic).
When I run a DELETE  on conditions, op=d message is sent to mynamespace.test.conditions topic. But then, Debezium tries to access a  topic "mynamespace.test._timescaledb_internal._hyper_2_2_chunk" and fails in my setup due to a permission issue with that naming...

evidence.quote: Often in SMT configurations, users don't predicate the SMT and if the SMT isn't designed to gracefully handle tombstone events, this can be a problem. You could try and disable tombstones"; reporter: "disabling tombstone solves my problem

notes: DELETE's tombstone is routed by the TimescaleDB SMT to the internal chunk topic; DELETE handling is unsupported/undocumented, workaround tombstones.on.delete=false, enhancement DBZ-8049 filed.
